watches.name: ANTARCTIC EROTIC GOLD
watches.description: The Antarctic Erotic Gold is a 38 mm Swiss hand-wound watch with an 18K yellow gold-plated 316L stainless steel case, a domed white matt dial with gold applied indexes, and an animated caseback mechanism: two 18K gold-plated penguins set over an ice-blue floe, visible through the sapphire caseback. They only move when you wind the watch. The penguin belongs to Nivada Grenchen's own history. The emblem was registered as a patent in 1965 and became a quiet signature engraved on the casebacks of vintage Antarctic models, inspired by mid-century polar expeditions. This edition redraws it from the original archival patent. Inside, a modified Soprod P054 hand-wound movement drives both the hands and the animation, at 28,800 vibrations per hour with a 42-hour power reserve. The case is shiny and brushed, 12.55 mm thick and 45 mm lug to lug, and water resistant to 10 ATM. A perforated racing leather strap in black or brown closes with an IP gold pin buckle engraved with the emblem. Availability: sold exclusively online on 9 and 10 October 2026, during We Love Watches. Shipping begins at the start of February 2027. watches.name: AUTOCHRON MECAQUARTZ
watches.description: The Autochron Meca-Quartz by Nivada Grenchen is a 38 mm stainless steel chronograph powered by the VK67 meca-quartz movement, combining quartz precision with a smooth sweeping chronograph hand. It has a rotating aluminum bezel with tachymeter scale, a double-domed sapphire crystal and 200 m water resistance. The design comes from a 1970s Autochron prototype found in the brand's archives. Like the original, the textured black dial carries Art Deco-style subdials, and the fluted bidirectional bezel shows a yellow marker at 12 o'clock. The VK67 is a hybrid: quartz keeps the time, a mechanical module runs the chronograph, so the hand sweeps and resets instantly. Accuracy is rated at ±20 seconds per month and the battery lasts about three years. More in What is a meca-quartz chronograph? Using the tachymeter: start the chronograph when a car sets off, stop it after one kilometre or one mile, and read the speed where the seconds hand stops. One kilometre in 30 seconds stops the hand at 120: an average of 120 km/h. Available with leather, steel and rubber strap options. See the full meca-quartz range . Inside beats the Swiss Soprod P024 automatic movement, three hands without date, at 28,800 vibrations per hour with a 38-hour power reserve. Strap options are black or brown leather, plain or with white stitching, black or brown racing straps, tropic rubber, and the beads of rice or flat link steel bracelets.
